subject: PrivDeploy commercial options and discretionary discount matrix
messages:
From: Sarah Edwards <sarah.edwards@neurohealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploring private deployment options and pricing

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at NeuroHealth is excited about the performance gains you showed. We're preparing an internal ask for a VPC/on-prem deployment for one of our research products and need a clear commercial picture to present.

High level:
- Target start: Q3 pilot (Aug)
- Expected steady state: 8 dedicated GPUs across two sites
- Priority: strict data isolation (on-prem) + 24/7 support for critical inference paths

We'd like a breakdown for:
1) Licensing model options (seat vs node vs per-GPU node)
2) Platform fee treatment (one-time vs annual amortization)
3) Support tiers with response times and estimated T&M for runbook ops
4) A discretionary discount / concession matrix tied to commits (12/24/36 months) and payment terms

Can you share a starting matrix and any standard SOW template? Also, any recent precedent for healthcare customers would help.

--
Sarah Edwards
Head of Infrastructure Strategy
NeuroHealth
sarah.edwards@neurohealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0132
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Edwards <sarah.edwards@neurohealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring private deployment options and pricing

Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated.

I can put together an options matrix that outlines: licensing constructs (per-GPU node vs site license), platform fee amortization examples, and a standard support ladder. To make the concession matrix practical can you confirm:
- Rough monthly token/throughput expectation (or attach the demand estimate)
- Whether you require on-prem air-gapped support (that changes runbook effort)
- Preferred term: 12/24/36 months?

I attached a short questionnaire and our base pricing matrix (v3) to start. I'll loop in Marissa (AE) for commercial negotiation and Vanessa (CS lead) for ops/runbook scope.

I'll aim to follow up with a draft concession grid and an SOW template by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0210

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, partner_questionnaire.pdf
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: NeuroHealth — draft concession matrix and packaging options (internal)

Team — copying the notes from Sarah and my reply. She confirmed an initial pilot (Aug) with anticipated steady-state of ~8 GPUs and strict on-prem isolation; their procurement is sensitive to amortization and NPV of platform fee.

Ask: can we assemble a recommended commercial posture with three tiers: Pilot (Q3), Production (steady state 8 GPUs), and Multi-site (growth scenario). Include:
- Licensing: node-based (per-GPU) + site entitlement option (for multiple sites)
- Platform fee: option A one-time on go-live, option B annual amortized (preferred by procurement)
- Support tiers: Standard (business hrs, 8x5), Premium (24x7 with 4-hr response), Critical (SLA-backed pager with 1-hr response)
- Discounts: sliding scale by term (12/24/36) and prepay (annual vs upfront) and commit bands (>=24 GPUs across accounts -> additional credit)

I drafted an initial grid (attached as pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx) and a starter SOW (proposed_sow_template.pdf). Key commercial levers I suggest we consider for NeuroHealth:
1) 10% partner/early-adopter credit for healthcare pilot if they sign before July 1
2) 5% additional off for 24-month commit paid annually in advance
3) Waive one-time platform onboarding fee for pilot if they convert to 24-month within 90 days

Priyom — need legal/finance to sign off on discretionary credit (10% pilot & onboarding waiver) and confirm whether platform fee can be amortized on our invoice terms (we typically prefer amortization via monthly invoice vs one-time).

Vanessa — can you outline runbook hours and approximate T&M for air-gapped on-site support?

Thanks — can we target a consolidated commercial we can send Sarah by Friday?

-Markus
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@neurohealth.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Edwards <sarah.edwards@neurohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring private deployment options and pricing

Markus / team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Sarah forwarded the draft; Tom here (procurement). Two quick data points to help firm concessions:

1) Preferred term is 24 months; procurement wants amortized platform fee across 24 months if possible.
2) We can commit to 24 months at the Pilot scale (8 GPUs) with a path to scale to 16 GPUs Y2 if performance & costs align.
3) Our finance team needs an example amortization schedule and the net-present-value impact of prepaying vs annual pay.

On discounts: the two levers that matter most are: (a) prepay vs invoice cadence, and (b) a guaranteed commitment to an expansion floor (if you give better unit price above 12 GPUs we can target that). Healthcare compliance add-on (HITRUST/SOC artifacts) may also be a paid item.

If you can share an updated grid with NPV examples (3 scenarios: invoice monthly, annual prepay, full upfront) and an attached SOW highlighting HITRUST evidence delivery cadence, we can move this quickly.

Thanks — Tom
Procurement Director, NeuroHealth
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Sarah Edwards <sarah.edwards@neurohealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@neurohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Decision log: concession matrix to send to NeuroHealth (final)

Folks — summary from our side after internal calibration; aim to share this with NeuroHealth today:

Commercial summary (for NeuroHealth Pilot -> 24-month commit):
- Licensing: per-GPU node license at $6,400 / GPU / month (pilot 8 GPUs)
- Platform fee: $120,000 one-time OR amortized option of $5,000 / month over 24 months (we will reflect either on invoice as monthly line-item)
- Support tiers: Premium (24x7) selected — $6,000 / month; Critical add-on (1-hr pager) optional at $10k/mo
- Upfront concessions we are offering: 10% pilot credit on first 6 months (early-adopter credit), waive onboarding fee ($20k) if they sign 24-month by July 1, additional 5% off unit price if they prepay Year 1 in full

NPV scenarios: Marissa — please attach the three NPV tables (monthly invoice / annual prepay / full upfront) to this thread and confirm the model assumptions (discount rate 6%, escalation 3% yr2). Also confirm whether the 5% prepay discount is combinable with the 10% pilot credit (I recommend yes but capped so combined discount not exceed 12%).

Priyom — request sign-off on the two discretionary items (10% pilot credit; onboarding waiver) and approval language for the SOW. If legal prefers not to promise onboarding waiver, propose alternative: 50% onboarding fee credit upon conversion.

Vanessa — confirm runbook T&M for air-gapped support and add a bullet on HITRUST evidence delivery cadence (we've committed 30 days for baseline artifacts, 90 days for full controls map).

Attachments to customer when we send: pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, neurohealth_demand_estimate.xlsx (they provided), proposed_sow_template.pdf, NPV_tables_{monthly,annual,upfront}.xlsx

Once Priyom gives legal ok I will send a concise commercial email to Sarah and Tom and ask for a procurement call next week.

-Markus
